# qualys_asset_group (Resource)

A Qualys asset group: a named set of scan targets referenced by scans, schedules
and reports.

Member lists are managed authoritatively. Removing an entry from the
configuration removes it from the group, and emptying a list empties it in
Qualys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualys_asset_group" "prod_web" {
  title = "prod-web"

  # Declare the intended Qualys network explicitly. Do not rely on the default,
  # and do not infer it from whether the addresses are public or private.
  network_id = var.qualys_network_id

  # CIDR is accepted and converted to the hyphenated ranges the Qualys API
  # expects, so this will not produce a permanent diff.
  ips = [
    "10.20.0.0/24",
    "10.20.4.10-10.20.4.20",
    "10.20.9.7",
  ]

  domains       = ["example.com"]
  appliance_ids = [var.scanner_appliance_id]

  division        = "Platform"
  function        = "Web tier"
  location        = "eu-west-1"
  business_impact = "high"
}
```

## IP address notation

`ips` accepts single addresses, hyphenated ranges, and CIDR blocks. CIDR is
converted to the hyphenated form the Qualys API documents, and responses are
normalised back, so `10.0.0.0/24` and `10.0.0.0-10.0.0.255` are equivalent and
neither produces a permanent diff. Ordering is not significant.

## Networks

`network_id` is fixed at creation. The Qualys edit action provides no way to move
an existing group to a different network, so changing this attribute forces
replacement rather than silently doing nothing.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **title** (String) Name of the asset group. Must be unique within the subscription.

### Optional

- **appliance_ids** (Set of String) Scanner appliance IDs assigned to this group.
- **business_impact** (String) Business impact rating, applied to every host in the group. One of `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `none`.
- **comments** (String)
- **cvss_enviro_ar** (String) CVSS environmental availability requirement. One of `high`, `medium`, `low`.
- **cvss_enviro_cdp** (String) CVSS environmental collateral damage potential. One of `high`, `medium-high`, `low-medium`, `low`, `none`.
- **cvss_enviro_cr** (String) CVSS environmental confidentiality requirement. One of `high`, `medium`, `low`.
- **cvss_enviro_ir** (String) CVSS environmental integrity requirement. One of `high`, `medium`, `low`.
- **cvss_enviro_td** (String) CVSS environmental target distribution. One of `high`, `medium`, `low`, `none`.
- **default_appliance_id** (String)
- **division** (String)
- **dns_names** (Set of String)
- **domains** (Set of String)
- **function** (String)
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **ips** (Set of String) IP addresses, hyphenated ranges, or CIDR blocks in this group.
- **location** (String)
- **netbios_names** (Set of String)
- **network_id** (String) ID of the Qualys network this group belongs to. Defaults to the Global Default Network (`0`) when omitted. Changing this forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- **last_update** (String)
- **owner_id** (String)
- **unit_id** (String)

## Import

Asset groups are imported by their numeric Qualys ID.

```shell
terraform import qualys_asset_group.prod_web 4021975
```
